findings.meaning: Extension files exposed to web pages: any site can load them and detect the extension (fingerprinting vector).
findings.remediation: narrow the `web_accessible_resources` match patterns

findings.title: extension-connectable: externally_connectable:<all_urls>
findings.snippet: matches ['<all_urls>']
findings.meaning: Websites may send messages to the extension: any site can talk to it (fingerprinting vector).
findings.remediation: replace `<all_urls>` in `externally_connectable` with the origins you actually message

findings.title: android-permission: READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
findings.snippet: <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE" android:maxSdkVersion="32" />
findings.meaning: Android app requests shared storage (READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE); the user must grant it and the app can read it. Only applies up to API 32 (newer Android does not request it).
findings.remediation: request the permission at first use, and add `android:maxSdkVersion` if only old versions need it

findings.title: android-feature: android.hardware.camera
findings.snippet: <uses-feature android:name="android.hardware.camera" android:required="true" />
findings.meaning: Manifest declares hardware feature android.hardware.camera: the app is expected to use that sensor/capability.
findings.remediation: request the permission at first use, and add `android:maxSdkVersion` if only old versions need it

findings.title: android-queries: android.intent.action.VIEW
findings.snippet: android.intent.action.VIEW
findings.meaning: Manifest <queries> intent filter: this app can discover handlers for https.
findings.remediation: declare only the packages you resolve, or prefer explicit intents over package visibility

findings.title: android-queries: com.example.partner
findings.snippet: <package android:name="com.example.partner"
findings.meaning: Manifest <queries> lists an installed app this app can see/discover (Android 11 package visibility).
findings.remediation: declare only the packages you resolve, or prefer explicit intents over package visibility
